question: Where can I find the closest fast food restaurant in the vicinity of Hubb's Farm (Home of Hubb's Corn Maze), Clinton, NC?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hubb''s Farm (Home of Hubb''s Corn Maze)%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Clinton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), 5000) -- Search within 5km radius ORDER BY geometry::geography <-> ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hubb''s Farm (Home of Hubb''s Corn Maze)%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Clinton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1;
